question.problem:
The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below. Sketch the graph of $y=4f(x).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14218586/assets/495e5e02f89dfa125cb95095088cb80cf3e83ab9e6dae619494e900cbe1dc346.png)
question.worked_solution:
To graph the function $y = 4f(x),$ we take the graph of $y = f(x)$ and stretch it by factor of $4$ parallel to the $y$-axis. This has the effect of multiplying the $y$-coordinates of all points on $y = f(x)$ by $4.$

The resulting graph is the solid blue curve shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14218586/assets/0b20c1355ae0b2e8afc7e7ce701662e0aaf2a6fdcd8e43342ae057e8bd9250e9.png)
